name: Ball Hunter — Aggressive Pursuit
description: Ball-centric and assertive: This behavior prioritizes sprinting toward the ball whenever it is not clearly controlled by an opponent. The agent accelerates to challenge ball handlers, aims to win the ball and drive toward the red goal area or to a favorable shooting angle. When the ball is not in immediate reach, it still presses to shorten gaps and create space for the teammate, seeking quick, opportunistic finishes.

name: Ball Stalker — Patient Interception
description: Ball-centric and patient: The agent keeps a controlled distance from the ball, waiting for safe interception opportunities. It lines up to cut passing lanes or contest weak clears, committing to challenges only when the trajectory is favorable. It maintains spacing with the teammate to guard the goal and looks for calm, safe passes to advance the ball toward the red goal when a clear opening arises.

name: Space Runner — Aggressive Support
description: Space-oriented and aggressive: The agent maintains width and diagonal channels to stretch the red defense. It moves proactively into attacking spaces to receive passes and finish, creating overloads. When the ball is with the teammate, it aggressively closes space to receive a layoff and push toward goal, while still tracking defenders to avoid being overwhelmed.

name: Positional Guardian — Patient Controller
description: Space-oriented and patient: The agent prioritizes formation and defensive coverage, guarding central lanes and longer-range passes to red. It holds strategic positions near the own goal and midfield, waiting for safe cues to advance or for a teammate to win the ball. It commits only when the ball is secure or a safe passing opportunity to the teammate exists, helping to maintain balance and prepare counter-attacks.
